response.sql: WITH region_counts AS (SELECT d.A3, COUNT(c.client_id) as client_count FROM client c JOIN district d ON c.district_id = d.district_id GROUP BY d.A3), totals AS (SELECT SUM(client_count) as total_clients, COUNT(*) as num_regions FROM region_counts), region_shares AS (SELECT rc.client_count, rc.client_count * 1.0 / t.total_clients as share, 1.0 / t.num_regions as avg_share FROM region_counts rc CROSS JOIN totals t) SELECT SUM(client_count) as total_clients_above_avg, AVG(share) as avg_share_above_avg, AVG(share - avg_share) as avg_distance_above_avg FROM region_shares WHERE share > avg_share
